contrast_increment.purpose: Separate whether frontier adds substantially beyond bookkeeping.

hypotheses.evaluator: Uniform independent ordered four-root product conditioned on public reset; qualification and sampling strata do not restrict H.
hypotheses.family: Prior 648 full-behavior root types plus 8 direct input/not-input roots. Compatible reset DSL; exact complete-behavior deduplication.
hypotheses.sampling: One direct, one interaction, one delay-or-latch, one repetition root; sensor slots randomly permuted.

interfaces.A: Prior generic Active system instruction and full authenticated ledger; change budget12 to6 only. Retain the pre-existing exact_probe_repeat_counts field; no new inquiry-state object.
interfaces.B: A plus explicit deterministic-reset/no-new-evidence fact and tested/untried legal IDs and completed/remaining counts.
interfaces.C: B plus complete grouped structural frontier; only IDs/sequences/tested membership used. No outcomes, causal labels, oracle values or recommendation.
interfaces.decoder: Exact shared dynamic legal-ID token trie plus EOS. Repeats retain full legal generative support. All82 IDs remain legal throughout.
interfaces.frontier_grouping: Each row {tested,structural_relation,untried:[IDs]} is losslessly equivalent to separate example rows.
interfaces.frontier_order: Tested IDs in fixed catalogue order; labels lexical; untried IDs in catalogue order. Include every matching pair/relation; no truncation or utility order.
interfaces.hypotheses: No model prose analysis calls and no unverified model hypotheses carried forward.
interfaces.predictions: Identical ledger-only query messages and product grammar in A/B/C; no inquiry state or frontier in prediction messages.

interpretation_limits: Small fresh-family screening, not confirmation or a Triangulation capability claim.
B changes both explicit bookkeeping and statement of a known reset fact; effects do not isolate those two components.
A already had the previous repeat-count field.
No hypothesis narrative occurs in any arm; this is not a separate causal test of narrative fixation.
Reduced repetition alone does not establish information benefit or the main cause of the old collapse.

metrics.axis_cards: Scoped temporal onset and contextual/order cards entailed by H, inherited definitions; no global independence or infinite-horizon claims.
metrics.information: Exact finite H; realized and expected bits, selected midrank/regret among82 legal probes, H and log2H.
metrics.prediction: Whole-trace exact plus per-step/per-bit accuracy. Invalid complete traces receive zero credit.
metrics.repeat: An identical executed reset sequence already in this arm/world ledger.
metrics.useful_contrast: Prior registered structural comparison (one-action prefix/suffix extension or adjacent swap), actual endpoint delta, realized information>1e-12; at most once per decision.

raw_first: commit rules before scientific world selection
commit raw manifest before any scientific scoring

scale_up.no_A_repeats: Cannot establish repeat-collapse reduction; screening gate fails.
scale_up.statistics: No p-value requirement. Publish all16 paired per-world differences, wins/ties/losses, medians and totals.
scale_up.type: Diagnostic recommendation only; no formal competence claim and no automatic larger study.

selection_rule: If B-A passes, recommend B unless C-A and C-B incremental gates also pass; then C. If only C-A passes, recommend C as a bundle. If neither passes, do not scale. Recommendation requires separate authorization.
technical_recovery: Never repeat a durable complete response. An incomplete technical request can resume identical frozen input/settings with authenticated attempt/interruption records, maximum3 attempts. No choice executes before response is durable. Corrupt/torn authentication stops for review.

world_admission.IDs: Shuffle82 legal sequences with prospective PRNG, assign P000..P081; shared by matched arms.
world_admission.direct: At least one singleton actuator changes a reset sensor; one actual direct input/not-input root also required by sampling.
world_admission.freshness: Exclude all prior causal, active-causal, triangulation scientific worlds and their engineering worlds, plus this pilot engineering worlds, up to graph isomorphism.
world_admission.modifier: A change in the second-action effect between B from reset and B after A, for some distinct A/B and sensor.
world_admission.oracle: Six legal probes, greedy expected information gain; at least five positive realized-information steps, at least eight bits, and both reserved outcomes identifiable. Offline admission only.
world_admission.sealed: Two seeded distinct length3 patterns per candidate, removed from all84 before ID assignment. Internally changing, distinct complete traces; never an allowed prefix.
world_admission.temporal: AB versus BA endpoint difference, or AAA first versus third observation difference (identical current actuator bit, different history).
